Name: Profile for Imagery Access Event Extension Version A
Description: The Profile for Imagery Access Event Extension Version A (PIAPEA) TRE is designed to provide an area for specific information about an event or events that are identified in an image. This extension shall be present for each event identified in an image. There may be up to 100 of these extensions present for each data type in an NITF file.

EVENTNAME.Name: The Image Event Name
EVENTNAME.Description: This field contains the recognized name of the event.

EVENTTYPE.Name: The Image Event Type
EVENTTYPE.Description: This field indicates the generic type of event associated with the product. For allowed values of this field go to "FieldRegistry" PIAEVA EVENTTYPE per paragraph 3.2 of Main Body of STDI-0002.
